label: defeated
definition: Argument 1 defeated argument 2 in an explicit sporting, electoral or other contest.
scope_notes: Choose beat/victory-over/sweep/outlast from this mixed dictionary. Playing, losing, transfers, speaking and residence are distinct predicates. Generic historical victories count without requiring every row to express the win.

facts.reason: Knicks explicitly beat and outlast Bulls and have a victory over them; the loss rows refer to other events.
China steals from United States in the sole path; this is not an explicit contest defeat.
Democrats control the White House; no opponent that they defeated is identified.
Clinton campaigns in New York. A campaign location does not establish victory over New York.
Mets trail and face Braves; neither path establishes a Mets victory.
